applicability_conditions: Applied to the thermal deformation (hot deformation) process of low-density high-strength Fe-Mn-Al-C steel, assumed to be controlled by hot activation.
purpose: Arrhenius hyperbolic sine function equation relating peak stress, temperature and strain rate, used to determine the dynamic recrystallization activation energy of the steel during hot deformation.

symbols.meaning: stress level factor (material constant), determined by the two constants n1 and β

unmapped: The stress level factor α is determined by α = β/n1 = (∂ln ε̇/∂σ)/(∂ln ε̇/∂ln σ) = 0.00599.
The rheological stress curve shows an obvious stress peak with peak stress/strain (σ_p/ε_p).
